films.name: Gold 200
films.description: Kodak Gold 200 is a classic consumer color negative film with warm tones, pleasant contrast, and forgiving exposure latitude. It delivers vibrant colors and a nostalgic film look, making it a versatile choice for everyday photography and sunny outdoor scenes.

films.name: Portra 400
films.description: Kodak Professional Portra 400 is a highly versatile color negative film known for natural color reproduction, soft contrast, and excellent skin tones. With fine grain and wide exposure latitude, it performs reliably in a wide range of lighting conditions and is widely used for portrait and lifestyle photography.
keyFeatures: Natural color and excellent skin tones
Ideal for portrait and people photography

films.name: Ektar 100
films.description: Kodak Professional Ektar 100 is a daylight-balanced color negative film known for extremely fine grain, high sharpness, and vibrant color saturation. It is especially well suited for landscape, nature, and scanning workflows where clean color and maximum detail are desired.

films.name: Portra 160
films.description: Kodak Professional Portra 160 is a daylight-balanced color negative film with very fine grain, soft contrast, and especially natural skin tones. It is a strong choice for portrait, fashion, and commercial work when you want a clean and refined look.
keyFeatures: Great for portrait and studio work

films.name: UltraMax 400
films.description: Kodak UltraMax 400 is a flexible consumer color negative film designed for everyday shooting in a wide range of lighting conditions. Its higher speed, bright color, and forgiving character make it a practical choice for travel, family, and general use.

films.name: ColorPlus 200
films.description: Kodak ColorPlus 200 is an affordable consumer color negative film with a simple, classic look and pleasant warm color. It is well suited for casual shooting, daylight photography, and anyone who wants an easy entry point into 35mm film.

films.name: 800T
films.description: CineStill 800T is a tungsten-balanced color negative film made for low light, night scenes, and artificial lighting. It is known for its cinematic look, strong neon response, and distinctive halation around bright highlights.
keyFeatures: Great for neon and city scenes

films.name: 400D
films.description: CineStill 400D is a daylight-balanced color negative film with fine grain, warm skin tones, and a wide dynamic range. It is designed to be highly versatile and works well for everything from daylight street shooting to indoor available light photography.
keyFeatures: Fine grain and warm skin tones

films.name: HP5 Plus 400
films.description: Ilford HP5 Plus 400 is a classic black and white film known for flexibility, dependable contrast, and strong push-processing performance. It is a favorite for documentary, street, travel, and low-light photography.
keyFeatures: Classic ISO 400 black and white film
Great for street and documentary work

films.name: Delta 100 Professional
films.description: Ilford Delta 100 Professional is a fine-grain black and white film built for maximum sharpness and clean tonality. It is especially well suited for landscapes, architecture, and detail-rich scenes where image quality is the priority.
keyFeatures: Very fine grain black and white film
Excellent for landscapes and fine detail

films.name: XP2 Super 400
films.description: Ilford XP2 Super 400 is a black and white film with fine grain, wide tonal range, and excellent exposure latitude. It is an easy all-round choice for photographers who want monochrome results with a forgiving and versatile character.
keyFeatures: Fine grain black and white film

films.description: Fujifilm 200 is a daylight-balanced color negative film that offers fine grain, natural color, and wide exposure latitude. It is a dependable everyday film for general shooting, travel, and bright outdoor conditions.
keyFeatures: Reliable for travel and daily shooting

films.name: Pro 400H
films.description: Fujifilm Pro 400H is a professional color negative film known for soft color, wide latitude, and beautiful skin tones. It has long been appreciated for portrait, wedding, and natural-light photography where a gentle and airy look is desired.
keyFeatures: Great for portrait and wedding work

films.name: Tri-X 400
films.description: Kodak Professional Tri-X 400 is a classic black and white film known for pronounced grain, strong contrast, and exceptional push-processing performance. It has been a staple of documentary, street, and reportage photography for decades and holds up well in difficult light.
keyFeatures: Iconic ISO 400 black and white film
Pushes exceptionally well to 1600 and beyond
A staple of documentary and street work

films.name: T-Max 400
films.description: Kodak Professional T-Max 400 is a modern black and white film built on a T-grain emulsion, giving noticeably finer grain and higher sharpness than traditional films of the same speed. It suits photographers who want ISO 400 flexibility with a clean, detailed rendering.

films.name: Portra 800
films.description: Kodak Professional Portra 800 is the fastest film in the Portra family, made for low light and indoor work while keeping the natural skin tones the line is known for. It buys extra shutter speed when light runs short, with finer grain than its speed would suggest.
keyFeatures: Finer grain than expected at this speed
Good for indoor and evening work

films.name: Ektachrome E100
films.description: Kodak Professional Ektachrome E100 is a daylight-balanced color reversal film with clean neutral color, extremely fine grain, and moderate contrast. Relaunched in 2018, it offers a more restrained alternative to heavily saturated slide films.

films.name: FP4 Plus 125
films.description: Ilford FP4 Plus 125 is a medium-speed black and white film with fine grain, high sharpness, and a classic traditional look. Its wide exposure latitude makes it forgiving to shoot and a strong choice for landscape, still life, and studio work.
keyFeatures: Well suited to landscape and studio

films.name: Pan F Plus 50
films.description: Ilford Pan F Plus 50 is a slow black and white film delivering extremely fine grain and outstanding sharpness. The low speed asks for good light or a tripod, and rewards it with very clean, detailed negatives.
keyFeatures: Best in bright light or on a tripod
Excellent for landscape and fine detail

films.name: Delta 3200 Professional
films.description: Ilford Delta 3200 Professional is a high-speed black and white film designed to be rated at EI 3200, though its true sensitivity sits closer to ISO 1000. It makes handheld shooting possible well after dark, at the cost of pronounced grain.
keyFeatures: High-speed film for very low light
Designed to be rated at EI 3200

films.name: Pan 400
films.description: Kentmere Pan 400 is an affordable black and white film from Harman offering medium contrast, moderate grain, and dependable results. It is a practical everyday option for shooters who want to work through a lot of film without a high cost per roll.
keyFeatures: Affordable ISO 400 black and white film
Made by Harman, makers of Ilford film

films.name: Velvia 50
films.description: Fujifilm Velvia 50 is a daylight-balanced color reversal film celebrated for extremely high saturation, punchy contrast, and very fine grain. Its narrow exposure latitude demands accurate metering, which is part of why it has such a devoted following among landscape photographers.
keyFeatures: High contrast and very fine grain

films.name: Provia 100F
films.description: Fujifilm Provia 100F is a daylight-balanced color reversal film with natural color, extremely fine grain, and more forgiving contrast than Velvia. It is the more versatile of Fujifilm's slide films and handles portraits, travel, and general work well.

films.name: Phoenix 200
films.description: Harman Phoenix 200 is Harman's own color negative film, made in the UK and released as an openly experimental product. It gives high contrast, strong grain, and vivid unconventional color, with narrow latitude that rewards careful exposure in good light.
keyFeatures: Made in the UK by Harman

films.name: Color Negative 400
films.description: Lomography Color Negative 400 is a versatile daylight-balanced color negative film with saturated color, fine grain, and good exposure latitude. It handles a wide range of light and suits everyday shooting, travel, and street photography.
